sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
BOM-LINE 110: part BR-180 (drawing Rev F); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6061-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
Move 40% of BR-180 volume at Plant 1 for STL from Alluminio B to C.

findings.why: Meccanica C S.p.A. has an OPEN 8D on cracks at fastener holes in EN AW-6061-T6 brackets. BR-180 is made of EN AW-6061-T6 and has 4 fastener holes. The proposal moves 40% of BR-180 volume to Meccanica C, so the open issue covers the material and the feature of this part. The source approval AP-0207 is current, so there is no source release finding.
